281725203.description:
Assorted Mineral & Gemstone Specimen Collection
Set of 4 Compartment Organizers
5.8 lbs Total Weight
This extensive mineral and rock collection includes a diverse assortment of rough mineral specimens, tumbled pocket stones, and crystalline formations organized across four multi-compartment plastic organizer cases. The collection features a broad variety of natural lapidary and geological specimens including clear quartz crystals, pyrite clusters, banded agate slabs, malachite chips, rose quartz, tiger's eye, howlite, snowflake obsidian, optical calcite, amethyst, and sodalite.
Four clear plastic compartment organizer cases keeping specimens sorted by variety
Wide assortment of geological specimens including both rough crystals and polished cabochons
Diverse specimen colors featuring translucent quartz, metallic pyrite, and banded agates
Includes US quarter coin visible in compartment for approximate scale
Condition:
Pre-owned collection in very good condition overall. Specimens exhibit natural geological variations, cleavage planes, raw mineral textures, and polished tumbled surfaces characteristic of natural stones. Plastic organizers show minor surface scuffing from handling and storage with all latches intact.
